messages.subject: Energy & Infrastructure Executive | ESG, Government Relations & External Affairs
messages.body:
Dear Douglas Stuart Search Team,

Your global executive-search work across energy, renewables, nuclear and infrastructure is directly relevant to my leadership profile. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibilities across government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional appointments where complex energy or infrastructure growth depends on institutional trust, regulatory discipline and responsible execution. I am internationally mobile, with Saudi Arabia and the UAE as priority markets.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
